day_shape: 47 items: reported explosions at US base near Erbil airport, Houthi claim of missile strikes on Aramco Jizan/Yanbu facilities (Greek air defence intercept reported), NYT-sourced US intel assessment that Mojtaba Khamenei leans further toward nuclear weapons, and heavy regime Arbaeen and martyred-leader messaging cycle.

threads.label: Reported strikes on US base near Erbil
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB reported explosions near Erbil airport in northern Iraq, with Arab sources cited as describing an attack on a US base. No party claimed responsibility and no casualty figures were released.

threads.label: Yemen–Saudi missile exchange
threads.summary: Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree claimed two operations against Aramco facilities in Jizan and Yanbu overnight, while the Jerusalem Post reported Greek personnel operating Saudi air defences intercepted two missiles targeting Yanbu refineries. Defa Press and Jerusalem Post also reported continued Houthi threats to Saudi shipping and a Saudi naval blockade.

threads.label: Arbaeen pilgrimage and martyred-leader messaging
threads.summary: Khamenei's office issued a message thanking the "tens-of-millions" presence at commemorations in Iran and Iraq, while IRIB and Defa Press ran extensive Arbaeen logistics coverage citing 250,000 pilgrims via Shalamcheh and 50,000 via Chazabeh. Multiple regime items amplified references to the "martyred leader" and sacred-defence themes.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and oil-price rhetoric
threads.summary: The head of the Armed Forces Judiciary told IRIB the Strait of Hormuz is "under the sovereignty of the Islamic Republic", and Defa Press quoted analyst Mahdi Hasanvand saying oil above $118 would give Iran the "upper hand in war equations". IRIB separately reported a $32 fall in international gold prices since Thursday.

threads.label: Nuclear succession and Iran covert-operations reporting
threads.summary: Times of Israel, citing the New York Times, reported a US intelligence assessment that new Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei is "far more" inclined to pursue nuclear weapons than his father. The Telegraph, via Iran International, reported Iran is using migrant smuggling routes to place operatives in Britain, and Iran International cited an ISPA poll showing nearly half of users angered by the wartime internet shutdown.

events.title_en: Chemiran: The movement arising from the funeral of our martyred leader has concerned America
events.summary_en: Chemiran: The movement arising from the funeral of our martyred leader has concerned America. The head of Tehran's Islamic City Council, during a visit to the city's Muharram commemoration, said: Throughout history we have had many movements, one of the most important of which is the Islamic Revolution. This year, the days of Muharram coincided with the martyrdom of our martyred leader, leaving a great wound on the hearts of our nation. We witnessed an example of this wound in the funeral procession of the martyred leader of the revolution in Tehran, Qom, Mashhad, Najaf and Karbala. I believe that if the body of the martyred leader had gone to other countries, the same affection and care towards him would have been shown. The movement created by the funeral ceremonies of the martyred leader of the revolution in Iran and Iraq opened a new chapter in the Islamic world.

events.summary_en: Death toll in Gaza war rises to 73,317. The Palestinian Ministry of Health in Gaza announced that the death toll in the Gaza war has risen to 73,317. According to a statement by the Palestinian Ministry of Health in Gaza, since the start of Zionist regime attacks on 7 October 2023, the number of wounded has risen to 173,961. The Gaza Ministry of Health noted that since a ceasefire was established on 11 October, 1,191 Palestinians have been killed and 3,853 wounded. The bodies of 803 martyrs have also been recovered from the rubble.

Commander Hassan Hasanzadeh, commander of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) Sepah of Greater Tehran, at an inter-agency coordination meeting regarding this year's commemoration of those who could not participate in Arbaeen in Tehran, said: Given that the event of those who could not participate in Arbaeen this year is in line with the historic funeral ceremonies of the nation's leader, this year's slogan is the same slogan of 'Rise up' and 'The clenched fist of the martyred leader' as a symbol of this ceremony. The march of those who could not participate in Arbaeen in Tehran has been held as a family event for some years, and this year too, the necessary arrangements for the presence of families have been made along the route.

events.summary_en: Spokesman for Yemen's armed forces: Last night we carried out 2 important military operations against Aramco facilities in Jizan and Yanbu. Brigadier Yahya Saree: This action was taken in response to Saudi aggression against the city and port of Hodeidah, Socotra Island, and the continued blockade of the Yemeni people and violation of Yemen's sovereignty. Based on field developments in the coming hours and days, within the framework of the equation 'blockade in response to blockade and escalation in response to escalation', we will have no doubt in expanding our actions and intensifying our steps. The escalation of aggression shows the insistence of the Saudi enemy on continuing the blockade of our people and violating our country's sovereignty; an action that is never acceptable.

events.summary_en: Spokesman for Yemen's armed forces: Air defence engaged a group of enemy aircraft that had entered airspace and prevented further crimes against this great people. Last night we carried out 2 important military operations against Aramco facilities in Jizan and Yanbu. This action was taken in response to Saudi aggression against the city and port of Hodeidah, Socotra Island, and the continued blockade of the Yemeni people and violation of Yemen's sovereignty. The first operation targeted sensitive objectives of Aramco facilities in Jizan with dozens of ballistic missiles and drones. The second operation targeted sensitive objectives of Aramco facilities in the city of Yanbu with several ballistic and cruise missiles and several drones.
